verdict.rationale: Salv is a compliance SaaS that ships an AI feature (AI-Powered Insights), so a buyer could fairly ask whether customer data trains AI models. However, the evidence pack contains no training opt-out, data-usage policy, or no-training commitment. On-premise or private cloud deployment is a different control and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
